name: Quality Construction Products Public Company Limited
summary: Quality Construction Products Public Company Limited (Q-CON), alongside its subsidiary, manufactures and supplies a comprehensive range of construction materials to markets both within Thailand and internationally. Their key offerings encompass autoclaved aerated concrete blocks, reinforced wall and floor panels, and lintels. The company's product portfolio further extends to include pre-fabricated counters, specialized mortars for plastering and adhesion, innovative aerated stair systems, and various tools and accessories. Founded in 1994, Q-CON is based in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, Thailand, and functions as a subsidiary of SCG Building Materials Company Limited.
